content.description:
About Highlevel

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are looking for a passionate and highly skilled Lead Software Engineer to join our Affiliate Manager & Loyalty Program Team. You will work on building scalable systems and user experiences that power affiliate marketing, referral tracking, commission management, loyalty rewards, and customer engagement across the HighLevel platform.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role with a strong focus on individual contribution. You will actively participate in designing, developing, and delivering complex features while providing technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers.

You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Platform teams to deliver high-impact features, improve product scalability and reliability, and drive engineering excellence.

This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, system design expertise, end-to-end ownership, and the ability to independently solve complex technical challenges at scale.
Core Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and frontend applications for Affiliate Manager and Loyalty Program.

Actively contribute to production code, taking ownership of complex features and technical initiatives from design through deployment.

Build and enhance systems for:

Affiliate campaign creation and management.

Affiliate tracking, attribution, and conversion reporting.

Commission calculation, tracking, and management.

Referral programs and automation workflows.

Loyalty points, rewards, and redemption management.

Customer engagement and retention.

Analytics and reporting.

Design and implement reliable APIs, microservices, and integrations with other HighLevel products and third-party platforms.

Lead technical design discussions and contribute to architectural decisions while remaining actively involved in implementation.

Collaborate with Product and Design teams during requirement gathering, technical feasibility assessments, and solution design.

Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and database efficiency.

Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code.

Identify and resolve complex technical challenges, production issues, and performance bottlenecks.

Drive technical improvements, code quality, and engineering best practices.
Technical Leadership & Execution
Take end-to-end ownership of complex features, including technical design, development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.

Act as a hands-on technical contributor while guiding engineers on implementation approaches and technical decisions.

Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve engineering quality.

Mentor engineers through technical discussions, pair programming, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Participate actively in sprint planning, technical estimations, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

Collaborate with QA to ensure comprehensive test coverage and high-quality releases.

Proactively identify technical risks, dependencies, and blockers and drive their resolution.

Contribute to improving development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automation, and engineering productivity.

Promote strong ownership, accountability, and collaboration across engineering teams.
Required Qualifications
6+ years of software engineering experience, with strong hands-on development expertise and experience owning complex technical initiatives.

Strong proficiency in:

Node.js

TypeScript / JavaScript

MongoDB

REST APIs

Experience building scalable backend systems and microservices.

Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and event-driven architectures.

Good knowledge of system design, software architecture, design patterns, and performance optimization.

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows.

Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to independently design, develop, and deliver complex features with strong ownership and accountability.

Experience conducting code reviews and providing technical guidance to other engineers.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.

Willingness to remain actively involved in hands-on development and individual contribution.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Vue.js or React.js.

Experience working with SaaS, MarTech, CRM, Affiliate Marketing, or Loyalty Management products.

Familiarity with:

Event-driven architectures.

Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies.

Firebase and ClickHouse.

Analytics and reporting systems.

High-volume transaction processing.

Experience with third-party API integrations, webhooks, and automation workflows.

Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS architectures.

Exposure to AI-powered or automation-driven products.

Experience working in fast-paced SaaS environments.
Tech Stack
Node.js

TypeScript / JavaScript

MongoDB / Firebase / ClickHouse

Vue.js / React.js

Redis

AWS / GCP

REST APIs & Microservices
What Success Looks Like
Consistently deliver high-quality, complex features through strong individual contribution and end-to-end ownership.

Build scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions for Affiliate Manager and Loyalty Program.

Make effective technical and architectural decisions while actively contributing to implementation.

Improve application performance, system reliability, and overall engineering quality.

Contribute to faster sprint execution, predictable delivery, and reduced technical debt.

Provide technical guidance and mentorship that improves the team's engineering capabilities.

Collaborate effectively across Product, QA, and Engineering teams.

Drive engineering excellence and continuously improve development practices.
EEO Statement:

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application
